skins.name: Shadow Self
skins.description: Shadow-Self costume earned as an award for defeating the Shadow-Self
skins.lore: Facing your Shadow can be the most difficult thing you'll ever do, and the outcome will depend on how much light you shine.

skins.name: Shade Tint
skins.description: Shade-like tint earned for defeating all foes within the 'Shade' category
skins.lore: Lurking in the shadows, Shades attempt to attach themselves to those who tread too close. The more suppressed their spirit, the darker their disposition, the better.

skins.name: Apparition Tint
skins.description: Apparition-like tint earned for defeating all foes within the 'Apparition' category
skins.lore: Apparitions aren't after anyone in particular. Appearing in ghostly forms they enjoy the thrill of the haunt, feeding off the fear of the foolish and their folly.

skins.name: Phantasm Tint
skins.description: Phantasm-like tint earned for defeating all foes within the 'Phantasm' category
skins.lore: Turning to your accomplice, you share just how uneasy the eerie traveling merchant made you feel. '...What merchant?'

skins.name: Phantom Tint
skins.description: It wanders lonely roads, forsaken trails, and abandoned tracks. The Phantom, a wayward soul in life now wanders the lower astral plane preying on the isolated.

skins.name: Wraith Tint
skins.description: Wraith-like tint earned for defeating all foes within the 'Wraith' category
skins.lore: You suddenly feel engulfed in fear & hatred. The setting somehow shifts to dark and dreary. A rogue wizard must have made an error, for wraiths are never more than pure terror.

skins.name: Poltergeist Tint
skins.description: Poltergeist-like tint earned for defeating all foes within the 'Poltergeist' category
skins.lore: * GLASS SHATTERING & CABINETS CRASHING * Poltergeists are natural tricksters and will use their environment to haunt their foe.

skins.name: Specter Tint
skins.description: Specter-like tint earned for defeating all foes within the 'Specter' category
skins.lore: Torment the mind, drain the life-force. Specters will often appear only after their adversary is questioning their sanity.

skins.name: Banshee Tint
skins.description: Banshee-like tint earned for defeating all foes within the 'Banshee' category
skins.lore: The Banshee and her beloved suffered a tragic death in their remote manor hundreds of years ago. The husband died first, and she had to witness the horror.

pets.name: Alpha Dog
pets.description: Award for being an Alpha Tester
pets.lore: Alpha Dogs have been loyal companions since the early days of HeroFit, back when there were no fancy titles or battles to be fought.

pets.name: Betta Fish
pets.description: Award for being a Beta Tester
pets.lore: The Betta Fish swim together, and support together. Their feedback remains an important asset to the progression of HeroFit.

pets.name: Plagueling
pets.lore: While it would appear that Plaguebringer only cares to inflict infectious devastation on the world, this is not true. He actually cares deeply for his pet noxious gas cloud.

titles.name: White Light Warrior
titles.description: Earned for an exceptional level of support during the early stages of development.

titles.name: The Renowned
titles.description: Title awarded for a 3 - battle win streak

titles.name: The Acclaimed
titles.description: Title awarded for a 5 - battle win streak

titles.name: The Untouchable
titles.description: Title awarded for a 10 - battle win streak

titles.name: The Dominator
titles.description: Title awarded for a 15 - battle win streak
